shippedExample.name: deployments/docker/config.yaml
shippedExample.input:
# swarm-device-access config file
# All settings are optional. CLI flags override file values.
# Send SIGHUP to reload this file without restarting the daemon.
# Settings marked [restart required] take effect only at startup.

# log-level: info        # debug | info | warn | error
# log-format: text       # text | json | plain
# log-time: false        # include timestamps in log lines

# docker-socket: /var/run/docker.sock   # [restart required]
# metrics-addr: ":9090"                 # Prometheus /metrics + /healthz + /readyz [restart required]
# debug-addr: ""                        # pprof endpoints [restart required]

# dry-run: false         # log rules without writing to cgroup

# Policy mode: opt-in (default) or all.
# opt-in: process only containers with label swarm-device-access.enable=true
# all:    process all containers unless swarm-device-access.enable=false
# policy-mode: opt-in

# Glob patterns for /dev/... paths to allow (empty = allow all).
# Per-container labels (swarm-device-access.device-allow) can narrow this further.
# device-allow:
#   - /dev/nvidia*
#   - /dev/dri/*

# Glob patterns for /dev/... paths to deny (deny takes priority over allow).
# Per-container labels (swarm-device-access.device-deny) add to this list.
# device-deny: []
